### YMCA turns crisis into capability at scale

YMCA partnered with Accenture to build a community-based model that helps refugees and displaced
people gain skills, find work, and rebuild their futures—moving from relief to long-term capability.

[
Read more
][135]

### How UNICEF's GenU is closing the youth skills gap

Through UNICEF’s partnership with Accenture, young people gain access to AI-powered skilling,
digital learning and entrepreneurship opportunities that connect them to employment and brighter
futures.

[
Read more
][136]

### Philipstown's wire cars go global

Philipstown’s wire car tradition is accelerating onto the global stage through immersive
storytelling, gaming and commerce—fueling opportunity and driving impact far beyond the track.

[
Read more
][137]

### Google Cloud reimagines lead enrichment with agentic AI

The leading hyperscaler replaced batch processing with an agentic model that delivers decision-ready
outputs up to 30x faster—sharpening prioritization while enabling more confident sales decisions.

[
Read more
][138]

### Bristol Myers Squibb scales AI to rewire everyday work

The life sciences leader is putting people at the center of its AI ambition—rewiring work across the
enterprise to empower employees, drive innovation and accelerate the delivery of therapies to
patients.

[
Read more
][139]

  [ Our Businesses ][52]
  * [Pharmaceutical, Medical Supplies & Products Distribution Services][53]
    
    We distribute pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to healthcare settings across North America,
    from pharmacies and hospitals to doctors’ offices and clinics.
    * [Pharmaceutical Distribution Services][54]
    * [Medical Supply Distribution][55]
  * [Pharmacy Services][56]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.
  * [Oncology & Multispecialty Solutions][57]
    
    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.
  * [Biopharma Capabilities][58]
    
    We provide a suite of solutions designed to address access, affordability and adherence
    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.
  * [Prescription Benefit Solutions][59]
    
    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.
  * [Consumer Products & Services][60]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]
[Person in a blue McKesson-branded jacket with arms crossed, standing in an industrial or warehouse
setting.]

and the word PHARMACY visible in the background.]

[Two scientists in a laboratory, one standing and reading a tablet, the other sitting and working at

### [ Biopharma Capabilities ][130]

[A person in a yellow shirt and gray cardigan holds a smartphone and a pill bottle, with a child in
the background.]

### [ Prescription Benefit Solutions ][131]

[Person sitting on the floor in a living room, wrapping a bandage around their elbow. A yellow
ottoman and a glass of water are in the background.]

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

[Worker pulls pallet jack quickly through a warehouse aisle, shelves lined with boxes, motion blur

Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

# Your Trusted Source for Security, AV and Smart Living Solutions

ADI is a leading distributor and solution provider of security, AV, and smart living products
serving over 100,000 customers worldwide. We offer access to a broad portfolio of products,
including top-tier distributed brands and our own exclusive brands.

With more than three decades of industry experience, we're committed to building long-lasting
customer relationships - making us a preferred partner for professionals across the industry.

# Our Mission

### We aim to provide products, services and software that help keep our communities safe, secure,
### comfortable and connected.

## Here's How We Do It

### Access to Exclusive Brands

We take pride in our exclusive, in-house manufactured products and software solutions, delivering
smart solutions that combine quality and innovation. From home automation to commercial-grade
infrastructure, we craft technologies that focus on what customers value most – delivering a
reliable and exceptional experience

[Access to Exclusive Brands]
[Support and Services]

### Support and Services

We offer a wide range of support and services to provide expert guidance at every step - from design
and configuration to ongoing support. With OvrC Remote Management, customers can easily manage,
configure, and troubleshoot devices across the network. OvrC is available on a range of exclusive
brand products and integrates with many leading distributed brands. Additional offerings include
systems design, technical support, rewards programs, training, project registration, and more.

### Robust Product Selection

With more than 500,000 products from over 1,000 trusted brands, ADI offers a carefully curated
selection of solutions to meet the needs for any application. We make purchasing easy - customers
can shop in-store or online and choose from multiple delivery options or in-store pickup.

[Robust Product Selection]

smart solutions that combine quality and innovation. From home automation to commercial-grade

reliable and exceptional experience

What types of healthcare software does AppDev develop?

AppDev specializes in creating custom healthcare software solutions for a variety of needs. This
includes Electronic Health Records (EHR) systems, patient portals, appointment scheduling tools,
telemedicine solutions, medical billing software, and more.

Why should I choose AppDev for my custom healthcare software project?

AppDev offers a unique combination of expertise in healthcare workflows, software development, and
HIPAA compliance. We work closely with you to understand your specific needs and create a solution
that integrates seamlessly with your existing systems.

What are the benefits of using custom healthcare software?

Custom software allows you to address your specific needs and challenges, improve operational
efficiency, enhance patient care, and gain a competitive edge in the healthcare industry.

Can AppDev integrate my custom software with existing systems?

Absolutely! We have experience integrating custom software with various healthcare IT systems,
ensuring seamless data flow and improved overall functionality.

How can I get started with a custom healthcare software project?

Contact AppDev today for a free consultation! We discuss your specific needs and provide a
customized quote to bring your vision to life.

### Frequently Asked Questions

If you can't find what you're looking for, please contact us and we'll be happy to help.

What types of healthcare software does AppDev develop?

AppDev specializes in creating custom healthcare software solutions for a variety of needs. This
includes Electronic Health Records (EHR) systems, patient portals, appointment scheduling tools,
telemedicine solutions, medical billing software, and more.

Why should I choose AppDev for my custom healthcare software project?

AppDev offers a unique combination of expertise in healthcare workflows, software development, and
HIPAA compliance. We work closely with you to understand your specific needs and create a solution
that integrates seamlessly with your existing systems.

What are the benefits of using custom healthcare software?

Custom software allows you to address your specific needs and challenges, improve operational
efficiency, enhance patient care, and gain a competitive edge in the healthcare industry.

Can AppDev integrate my custom software with existing systems?

Absolutely! We have experience integrating custom software with various healthcare IT systems,
ensuring seamless data flow and improved overall functionality.

How can I get started with a custom healthcare software project?

Contact AppDev today for a free consultation! We discuss your specific needs and provide a
customized quote to bring your vision to life.

Discover more about us?

Head over to our Contact Us page to get started.

# Get healthy, stay healthy

Our award-winning doctors and specialists are ready to provide the personal attention you and your
family need.

[Get Urgent Care][49]

[Sign in to MyChart][50]

[Pay My Bill][51]

[Find a Doctor][52]

## Stop pushing through joint pain

Start getting award-winning orthopedic care.

[Learn More][53]
[Illustration of a man with hip and knee pain speaking to his doctor.]

## Our areas of care

[Specialties][54]

Cutting-edge care from award-winning specialists, programs and nationally recognized centers of
care.

[Conditions][55]

Comprehensive care for a wide range of conditions so we can treat as many of our neighbors as
possible.

[Treatments & Services][56]

Tailored treatment plans with personal attention, diagnostic screenings, and a variety of convenient
and local services.

## Find a location

We offer more than 550 conveniently-located care sites across New Jersey.

HospitalsOur hospitals are committed to compassionate, patient-centered care for adults and
children.
Urgent Care Timely care for the whole family, with locations conveniently located throughout
northern and central New Jersey.
Emergency CareEmergency departments are open 24/7 and staffed by doctors trained to handle
emergencies.
Laboratory ServicesWe offer many convenient lab locations for diagnostics and screening tests in
family-friendly environments.
Imaging & Radiology LocationsState-of-the-art imaging services for a wide range of patient needs
with the highest quality and safety.
Rehabilitation & Physical Therapy CentersWe offer convenient locations for outpatient
rehabilitation, physical therapy and occupational therapy.

and more, all from one number. Message and data rates apply.

## Healthcare Professionals

Committed to helping you enhance your practice and the experience of your patients through connected
devices and digitalised data sharing.

[Healthcare Professionals][9]
* [ Primary Care ][10]
  
  Supporting every aspect of your clinical practice, including physical exam, diagnostic cardiology,
  vitals monitoring and vision screening
* [ Hospital Care ][11]
  
  Advancing products and technologies designed to speed patient recovery and streamline clinical
  workflows
* [ Surgical Care ][12]
  
  Delivering innovations that enable reduced operating times, faster patient recovery and improved
  outcomes
* [ Nutritional Care ][13]
  
  Personalizing nutritional care designed to improve patients’ health in the hospital, the ICU and
  at home
* [ Respiratory Health ][14]
  
  Helping your patients with respiratory therapies designed to simplify delivery and improve
  mobility
* [ Our Products & Services ][15]
  
  Our portfolio of acute, nutritional, hospital and surgical care products helps advance healthcare
  around the world.

## Perspectives

For nearly a century, we have worked at the intersection of saving and sustaining lives.

[Perspectives][16]
* [ Patients' Stories ][17]
  
  Patients’ journeys inspire our work and drive our commitment.
* [ Healthcare Insights ][18]
  
  We’re engaging with industry thought leaders to explore how science and innovation advance
  healthcare.
* [ People of Baxter ][19]
  
  We are a community of diverse professionals working together to drive better healthcare options.
* [ Community Engagement ][20]
  
  Enriching the communities where we live and work.

## Our Story

Our 90-year heritage gives us distinct perspective on the needs of patients and caregivers. We lead
today by putting those insights to work to deliver new, better healthcare solutions and access to
care in the communities where we live and work.

[Our Story][21]
* [ Our Leadership ][22]
  
  Our forward-looking leadership team is a driving force in ensuring we meet the needs of all our
  stakeholders – every day and everywhere.
* [ Our Governance ][23]
  
  We are proud of our strong commitment to maintaining the highest standards of corporate
  governance.
* [ Fueling Collaborative Innovation ][24]
  
  Nurturing a culture of innovation is critical to delivering on our mission to save and sustain
  lives. We partner with the healthcare community to continually find more efficient, smarter ways
  to help solve the world's most pressing healthcare challenges.
* [ Baxter Sustainability ][25]
  
  We strive to create lasting value by delivering sustainable healthcare, advancing climate and
  resiliency, and championing our people and communities.
* [ Inclusion & Diversity ][26]
  
  We are committed to attracting, motivating and retaining an inclusive and diverse workforce.
* [ Our History ][27]
  
  For nearly a century, we’ve been focused on saving and sustaining lives and elevating patient
  care.

## Patients

Helping you reach a healthy life, full of possibility.

[Patients][28]
* [ General Healthcare ][29]
  
  Whether you are receiving care in the hospital, at your doctor’s office or at home, we are here to
  support every step of your journey.
* [ Nutritional Care ][30]
  
  When medical conditions prevent you from adequately feeding yourself, we provide life-saving
  clinical nutrition options to help you regain your nutritional status.
* [ Respiratory Health ][31]
  
  We are committed to helping you with innovative products that deliver effective, proven
  respiratory therapy in the hospital and at home.

# Uniting to Save and Sustain Lives

## Redefining Healthcare Delivery

We are everywhere healthcare happens – and everywhere it is going, with essential solutions in the
hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare
providers rely on our unmatched portfolio of connected solutions, medical devices, and advanced
injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining
how care is delivered to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

## The future of healthcare is connect

hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare
providers rely on our unmatched portfolio of connected solutions, medical devices, and advanced
injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining

Healthcare is at a turning point. Clinicians face growing workloads, while patients increasingly
expect seamless, coordinated experiences. Despite recent advances in technology, medical devices and
clinical systems continue to be isolated from each other, preventing effective data sharing,
creating inefficiencies and increasing the potential for gaps in care. The future demands better
connectivity.

Leading digital health, advancing care, and transforming healthcare for a more interconnected
future.

## How We Help

We help healthcare providers improve care delivery, boost operational efficiency, and strengthen
cybersecurity through integrated solutions that connect systems and enhance mobility.

Connected Health is the healthcare specialisation of Wavelink, underpinned by deep industry
expertise, market- and technology-leading solutions, and strong channel services. Delivered through
our trusted channel partners, our purpose-built solutions are supported by tailored training and
change management, enabling secure, seamless, and efficient care environments.

Connected Aged Care solutions empower providers to enhance communication, collaboration, and
workflow efficiency through a secure-by-design wireless network. By seamlessly connecting care teams
and enabling prompt responses to residents' needs, these solutions drive operational excellence,
ensuring sustainable, high-quality care.

expectations, fostering a sustainable and adaptable healthcare model for evolving needs.

# Connected Health

Leading digital health, advancing care, and transforming healthcare for a more interconnected
future.

[ Discover our solutions ][47]

## How We Help

We help healthcare providers improve care delivery, boost operational efficiency, and strengthen
cybersecurity through integrated solutions that connect systems and enhance mobility.

Connected Health is the healthcare specialisation of Wavelink, underpinned by deep industry
expertise, market- and technology-leading solutions, and strong channel services. Delivered through
our trusted channel partners, our purpose-built solutions are supported by tailored training and
change management, enabling secure, seamless, and efficient care environments.

## Our Healthcare Solutions

[ [dummy] ][48]

### Aged Care

Connected Aged Care solutions empower providers to enhance communication, collaboration, and
workflow efficiency through a secure-by-design wireless network. By seamlessly connecting care teams
and enabling prompt responses to residents' needs, these solutions drive operational excellence,
ensuring sustainable, high-quality care.

[ Learn more ][49]
[ [dummy] ][50]

### Private Healthcare

Connected Healthcare solutions empower private providers to enhance patient care, streamline
operations, and remain competitive. By optimising mobility, strengthening interoperability, and
ensuring robust security, these solutions enable facilities to scale services and meet consumer
expectations, fostering a sustainable and adaptable healthcare model for evolving needs.

[ Learn more ][51]
[ [dummy] ][52]

### Public Healthcare

Connected Healthcare solutions empower public healthcare providers to deliver compassionate,
patient-centred care. By advancing mobility, strengthening interoperability, and ensuring robust
security, these solutions help facilities meet community needs, expand accessibility, and prioritise
equitable, high-quality care for all.

[ Learn more ][53]

## Featured Insights

[featured image]
Featured

## [ Why attack surface management must become a healthcare imperative ][54]

Healthcare’s expanding digital footprint requires continuous visibility. Attack Surface Management
reduces external exposure and strengthens resilience to protect critical systems.

[ Learn more ][55]
[featured image]
Featured

## [ Clinical mobility at scale: why mobile device management is essential for healthcare’s digital
## future ][56]

Mobile Device Management is essential to secure, scalable clinical mobility, enabling healthcare
providers to deliver seamless, connected care across expanding digital health networks.

[ Learn more ][57]
[featured image]
Featured

## [ Connected teams, better care: enabling the mobile workforce in modern healthcare ][58]

Discover how single-device mobility supports the healthcare workforce by reducing friction,
improving efficiency, supporting staff safety, and enabling clinicians to deliver sustainable,
high-quality care.

[ Learn more ][59]
[featured image]
Featured

## [ Delivering proof of concept to minimise risk and maximise value in healthcare technology
## implementation ][60]

Before implementing new healthcare technology, a Proof of Concept (PoC) is vital. It validates
feasibility, mitigates risks, aligns solutions with objectives, and informs decisions. Connected
Health’s PoC initiatives, spanning mobility, interoperability, workflow, and cybersecurity, enhance
efficiency, foster innovation, and improve patient outcomes. Let’s shape the future of care
together.

[ Learn more ][61]
[featured image]
Featured

## [ Building the foundations for secure, scalable, patient-centric data in ANZ healthcare ][62]

ANZ healthcare faces rising data, cyber threats, and sovereignty demands. Modern object storage
provides scalable, secure, resilient foundations that support regional care, research, and digital
maturity.

[ Learn more ][63]

### Why Demigos?

We create custom solutions for startups
that clients love. Here’s how:

Laser focus on value
We know how important it is to build IT solutions that bring measurable value to your startup or
company. We begin by asking the right questions, analyzing, and figuring out what solutions will
have the most significant impact on your business.
Flexibility
Flexibility is our top priority when developing software solutions. Requirements can change
mid-flight, and we’re ready to optimize and accommodate even last-minute changes. This is a major
advantage of custom software development for your startup or company over off-the-shelf solutions.
Scalability
Some solutions are expected to be successful, while the success of others leaves their creators
surprised. But in both scenarios, scalability is critical. The architecture of our software
solutions is designed to scale to one million daily active users and even more.
Design
When users love a product, they’re eager to recommend it. In that case, the design is just as
important for us as product functionality. We know how to build IT solutions for startups that are
robust, beautiful, easy-to-use, and, most importantly, loved by users.
Security
Data security is essential, especially in healthcare or financial services. As a software provider,
Demigos takes the security of our solutions for startups and companies very seriously. We follow
best practices for pinpointing vulnerabilities, architectural risk analysis, penetration testing,
and examining how a system behaves under attack. Security requirements and operations are at the top
of our list.
Quality
When it comes to startup product development, we raise the bar on quality. Our testing process
covers automation, performance, and unit testing—all it takes to make sure we deliver exceptional
products.

### IT Solutions for Your Business

Analyzing business needs and goals
Tasked with developing custom software development for startups and established companies, we start
by identifying the client’s business objectives. We’ll work together with you to understand your
pain points and how our IT solutions can help.
Developing a product vision and roadmap
We create a compelling product vision and a clear roadmap after detailed business analysis and
product prototyping.
Building the product
At Demigos, we strongly believe custom software development is most successful when it’s agile. That
is why we work according to the Scrum methodology and deliver results once every two weeks.
Getting feedback and optimizing
We always listen to the feedback our clients and their customers provide to fine-tune the product
and help it match your business goals.

### Services we offer

We focus on building products. We integrate solutions into your business processes that can bring
the greatest value for your business. Here is how we implement the process:

* Market analysis
* Business processes analysis
* Customer development
* Development strategy

#### Design & Prototyping

* UI / User Interface
* Prototyping & Testing

#### Technology & Development

* Machine Learning
* Computer Vision

## Our Custom Healthcare Software Development Services

From patient management systems and ERP solutions to specialized medical apps, our custom software
development for healthcare yields HIPAA and GDPR compliant software for quality care.

### [Healthcare App Development ][149]

Our healthcare app development services offer a versatile suite of digital tools & patient
engagement solutions, including [telehealth apps][150], remote monitoring, & [wearable apps,][151]
to simplify patient-provider communication for better daily health management.

### [Epic Integration Services ][152]

Our [Epic integration services][153] help achieve seamless [EMR/EHR integration][154] using [HL7 and
FHIR][155] standards, making it easy for interoperable software to share records and help medical
departments coordinate care more effectively.

### [AI Diagnostics & Medical Imaging ][156]

Our custom healthcare software development company delivers [AI solutions][157] that augment human
capabilities without replacing them, expanding care access, enabling early detection through medical
imaging, & personalizing care through NLP/ML.

### [Healthcare ERP Solutions ][158]

Our healthcare software development services cover a wide range of ERP needs, including [Healthcare
ERP solutions][159], Pharmaceutical ERP, Pharma Biotech ERP, and Medical Device ERP, each designed
to optimize processes and improve compliance.

### [Biotech Software Development ][160]

Through custom healthcare software development service expertise, we create HIPAA and 21 CFR Part
11-compliant [biotech solutions][161] like LIMS, ELNs, and AI research tools that unify data, ensure
compliance, and accelerate discoveries.

### [Medical Billing & Claims ][162]

Our custom operations management software helps healthcare teams run more efficiently and use
resources better. [Medical billing solutions][163] let patients communicate securely with providers,
pay bills through RCM software, and reduce administrative tasks.

## Our Custom Healthcare Software Development Services

From patient management systems and ERP solutions to specialized medical apps, our custom software
development for healthcare yields HIPAA and GDPR compliant software for quality care.

### [Healthcare App Development ][149]

Our healthcare app development services offer a versatile suite of digital tools & patient
engagement solutions, including [telehealth apps][150], remote monitoring, & [wearable apps,][151]
to simplify patient-provider communication for better daily health management.

### [Epic Integration Services ][152]

Our [Epic integration services][153] help achieve seamless [EMR/EHR integration][154] using [HL7 and
FHIR][155] standards, making it easy for interoperable software to share records and help medical
departments coordinate care more effectively.

### [AI Diagnostics & Medical Imaging ][156]

Our custom healthcare software development company delivers [AI solutions][157] that augment human
capabilities without replacing them, expanding care access, enabling early detection through medical
imaging, & personalizing care through NLP/ML.

### [Healthcare ERP Solutions ][158]

Our healthcare software development services cover a wide range of ERP needs, including [Healthcare
ERP solutions][159], Pharmaceutical ERP, Pharma Biotech ERP, and Medical Device ERP, each designed
to optimize processes and improve compliance.

### [Biotech Software Development ][160]

Through custom healthcare software development service expertise, we create HIPAA and 21 CFR Part
11-compliant [biotech solutions][161] like LIMS, ELNs, and AI research tools that unify data, ensure
compliance, and accelerate discoveries.

### [Medical Billing & Claims ][162]

Our custom operations management software helps healthcare teams run more efficiently and use
resources better. [Medical billing solutions][163] let patients communicate securely with providers,
pay bills through RCM software, and reduce administrative tasks.

## **Leading global businesses choose Econsultancy **

From FMCG manufacturers to omnichannel retailers, broadcasters to pharmaceutical firms, the world’s
most established businesses rely on our marketing and ecommerce expertise.

Econsultancy’s mix of learning formats and in-depth ecommerce content has really helped to raise our
game.

Beauty & Wellbeing Chief Customer and Digital Commerce Officer, Unilever

Econsultancy have enhanced our capabilities through a bespoke learning and development program.
Employees' feedback has been exceptional, and we expect to see a real financial impact from the
partnership.

Tina Christison

Group CRM & Analytics Director, Group Marketing, Specsavers

[Customer stories][45]

Our continuous and collaborative learning approach - delivered by our expert programme managers with
years of experience managing complex environments - helps marketing, ecommerce and L&D leaders
upskill at scale and drive change across teams.

[Learn more][46]

We prioritise learner participation with a mix of formats, channels and fast track courses that see
significantly higher engagement rates.

Whether it’s a workplace assignment or an interactive webinar, all our training is led by
experienced practitioners and focused on real-world outcomes.

[ Learn more ][48]

We demonstrate clear results from your learning programme, with an extensive range of scores,
surveys, tracking and benchmarking.

[ Learn more ][49]

Whatever your focus, our expert team will work with you to develop and deploy tailored upskilling
programmes to meet your goals for long term success.

[ Learn more ][50]

From customised off-the-shelf courses to bespoke learner journeys, we tailor our training
specifically for your team and budget.

engagement

Mix a blend of on-demand, live and structured learning into a programme designed exclusively for
your team

[Learn more][51]

Our on-demand learning platform helps individuals, teams and organisations to reach their goals as

With over 330 on-demand lessons in marketing, ecommerce, customer experience and data analytics,

Scale up with blended learning at on demand prices, with our exclusive fast track courses.

[Learn more][52]

gaps and benchmark results.

See how your team, department and whole organisation stacks up against competitors in your

# **Who We Are**

FasterCapital is a global venture builder and online incubator dedicated to co-funding and
co-founding innovative startups. Established in 2014, we are now #1 venture builder in terms of
number of startups that we have helped, money invested and money raised. We have supported over 1620
startups in raising more than $2.8 billion, while directly investing over 1 billion in 1145
companies. Our comprehensive support system includes a worldwide network of [mentors][166],
[investors][167], and [strategic partners][168], allowing us to transform ideas into scalable,
market-ready businesses.

Capital][193] program.

Welcome to the HL7® FHIR® Foundation, the home for FHIR Implementers. [FHIR][11] (Fast Health
Interoperability Resources) is an [HL7][12] specification for Healthcare Interoperability.

[Sam Boadi named CEO of South Tampa and West Tampa hospitals][100]

July 24, 2026

Boadi comes to the position from HCA Florida Oak Hill Hospital, where he served as chief operating
officer.

[HCA Florida Northside Hospital earns highest rating for Heart Care from Society of Thoracic
Surgeons][101]

July 23, 2026

The STS star rating system is one of the most respected measures of quality in cardiothoracic
surgery and is based on outcomes including mortality, complications, and adherence to best
practices.

July 23, 2026

Learn lifesaving skills for free this August. HCA Florida Healthcare is offering free Stop the
Bleed® training in Bradenton, Venice and Fort Myers, with Hands-Only CPR instruction also available
at the Venice and Fort Myers sessions.

## All types of plans for all types of people

### [Health insurance plans][13]

Explore a range of individual and family plan options, including ACA Marketplace plans.

### [Medicare plans][14]

Find coverage that goes beyond Original Medicare, including Medicare Advantage plans.

### [Medicaid plans][15]

See Medicaid plan options if you have low income or qualify due to a special circumstance.

### [Dental, vision and supplemental plans][16]

Browse plans that can help you get coverage for medical costs not covered by your medical plan.

## Frequently asked questions about health insurance

### What is health insurance?

Health insurance is a plan, or policy, that covers a percentage of doctors’ visits and hospital
bills. It helps offset the costs of both planned and unplanned medical needs. Medical care can be
expensive, but health insurance may help lessen the financial burden.

And health insurance isn’t just for when you’re sick or injured. It can also help you stay healthy
through preventive care and wellness programs. This may help you save money, too, by catching
potential health concerns before they become larger issues.

### How does health insurance work?

Health insurance is a contract between you and an insurance company (the insurer). When you purchase
a plan, you become a member of that plan. Each month, you’ll likely pay a fee, called a premium, to
use the plan.

There are many different types of health plans, but they generally work the same way. You pay for
some medical costs and your insurer pays for some costs. How those costs break out depend on your
specific plan benefits and coverage.

[Learn more about how health insurance works][17]

### How do I get health insurance?

Finding the right health insurance plan depends on a variety of factors. These include things like
your age, health and financial situation. For example, if you’re over 65 or have a qualifying
disability or special situation, you may be eligible for [Medicare][18]. If you have a lower income,
you may qualify for [Medicaid][19]. If you want to purchase an individual plan, an [Affordable Care
Act (ACA)][20] plan could be an option. Or, you may have the option to get [health insurance through
your employer][21].

Most health insurance plans have a special period of time, usually once a year, when you can enroll.
This is called open enrollment. It’s when you can start, stop or change your health plan. Timing of
open enrollment varies based on the plan.

[Learn more about open enrollment][22]

### What are the different types of health insurance?

There are a variety of health insurance plans that fit different needs. Some plans are offered
through the government, like [Affordable Care Act (ACA)][23] plans, [Medicare][24] plans and
[Medicaid][25] plans. There are also health plans you can get through your employer. Or, you can
purchase a plan on your own, like [short term health insurance][26] that offers coverage for a
limited amount of time. Understanding the different health insurance options can help you find the
plan that may work best for you.

You may also see terms like HMO, PPO, EPO and POS ­— these refer to the four basic kinds of provider
networks that certain health plans may offer. A network may include doctors, hospitals and other
providers that agree to provide services to plan members at a negotiated rate. This may help lower
your out-of-pocket costs.

[Learn more about the different types of health insurance][27]

### How much does health insurance cost?

It depends. A variety of factors impact how much you pay. These can include your age, your location
and lifestyle habits. It also depends on the type of plan you choose. With some plans, you may pay
less up front, but more when you receive care. For other plans, the opposite can be true.

plan.

And health insurance isn’t just for when you’re sick or injured. It can also help you stay healthy
through preventive care and wellness programs. This may help you save money, too, by catching
potential health concerns before they become larger issues.

### How does health insurance work?

Health insurance is a contract between you and an insurance company (the insurer). When you purchase
a plan, you become a member of that plan. Each month, you’ll likely pay a fee, called a premium, to
use the plan.

There are many different types of health plans, but they generally work the same way. You pay for
some medical costs and your insurer pays for some costs. How those costs break out depend on your
specific plan benefits and coverage.

[Learn more about how health insurance works][17]

### How do I get health insurance?

Finding the right health insurance plan depends on a variety of factors. These include things like
your age, health and financial situation. For example, if you’re over 65 or have a qualifying
disability or special situation, you may be eligible for [Medicare][18]. If you have a lower income,
you may qualify for [Medicaid][19]. If you want to purchase an individual plan, an [Affordable Care
Act (ACA)][20] plan could be an option. Or, you may have the option to get [health insurance through
your employer][21].

Most health insurance plans have a special period of time, usually once a year, when you can enroll.
This is called open enrollment. It’s when you can start, stop or change your health plan. Timing of
open enrollment varies based on the plan.

[Learn more about open enrollment][22]

### What are the different types of health insurance?

There are a variety of health insurance plans that fit different needs. Some plans are offered
through the government, like [Affordable Care Act (ACA)][23] plans, [Medicare][24] plans and
[Medicaid][25] plans. There are also health plans you can get through your employer. Or, you can
purchase a plan on your own, like [short term health insurance][26] that offers coverage for a
limited amount of time. Understanding the different health insurance options can help you find the
plan that may work best for you.

You may also see terms like HMO, PPO, EPO and POS ­— these refer to the four basic kinds of provider
networks that certain health plans may offer. A network may include doctors, hospitals and other
providers that agree to provide services to plan members at a negotiated rate. This may help lower
your out-of-pocket costs.

[Learn more about the different types of health insurance][27]

### How much does health insurance cost?

It depends. A variety of factors impact how much you pay. These can include your age, your location
and lifestyle habits. It also depends on the type of plan you choose. With some plans, you may pay
less up front, but more when you receive care. For other plans, the opposite can be true.

[Learn more about health insurance costs][28]

### What does health insurance cover?

Coverage is unique to each health plan. Many plans may cover things like preventive care,
prescription drugs, hospital stays, mental health services and more. A plan may cover the full cost
of certain services, or you may have to share costs (by paying a copay or coinsurance, for example)
until you meet a deductible or out-of-pocket limit.

Make sure to review benefits and coverage before choosing a plan. You can find this information in
the plan’s Summary of Benefits and Coverage. This is a document that all health plan companies are
required to provide. It outlines what’s covered, partially covered or not covered under a health
plan.

[Learn how to review a Summary of Benefits and Coverage][29]
[Learn more about health insurance][30]
[Get the facts about how the health system works][31]

UnitedHealthcare puts care at the heart of health insurance. Empathy, transparency and human
connection guide us. Because better care comes from understanding what people need — and making
quality care more personal.

maintainability.

interoperability standards from day one — no gaps, no rework.

01

### Integration Discovery

interoperability gaps.

02

compliance built-in.

connections.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What is Hola Health?

Hola Health is a secure on-demand telehealth provider in Australia. Available all year round, Hola
Health connects you with AHPRA-registered doctors or medical practitioners for online medical
certificates, instant scripts or new prescriptions (where clinically appropriate), specialist
referrals, and general consultations typically within 15 minutes (Based on typical wait times; may
vary by demand and practitioner availability). Access bulk billing doctor consults after hours for
urgent medical advice available for eligible Medicare cardholders.

### Is Hola Health safe?

Hola Health operates within Australian clinical and privacy standards. As with all healthcare
services, individual outcomes depend on clinical assessment. We prioritise the privacy of your data.
All patient information is stored on highly secure, encrypted servers hosted within the Australian
Data Centre, conformant to ISO 27001 standards. All data is encrypted at rest and in transit using
enterprise-grade encryption protocols. Hola Health is an [Australian Digital Health
Agency-registered platform][105], which means we follow strict privacy guidelines under the
[**Australian Privacy Principles**][10

We empower users to live their healthiest lives by optimizing their health, fitness, and wellness

# With You Every Moment

Our proprietary Zepp Digital Health Management Platform, which includes the Zepp OS, AI chips,
biometric sensors, and data algorithms, delivers cloud-based 24/7 actionable insights and guidance
to help users attain their wellness goals.

# Putting the Control Back
# into the Hands of Users

By developing intelligent healthcare tools and utilizing generative AI solutions, we put the control
of well-being back into hands of users, so they can understand their data and take steps to engage

# Healthcare Tools

hearing solutions which leverage the expertise of leading audiologists - put health at the center of

Along with AI-powered sports and sleep coaching algorithms which adjust based on the user's

## **Zepp Health is committed to delivering cutting-edge smart wearable healthcare solutions that go
## beyond necessity, to inspire and bring joy to our users.**

# A World-Leading Health & Fitness Ecosystem

We empower users to live their healthiest lives by optimizing their health, fitness, and wellness
journeys through our cutting-edge smart watches, bands, hearables and soundscape service.

# With You Every Moment

Our proprietary Zepp Digital Health Management Platform, which includes the Zepp OS, AI chips,
biometric sensors, and data algorithms, delivers cloud-based 24/7 actionable insights and guidance
to help users attain their wellness goals.

# Putting the Control Back
# into the Hands of Users

By developing intelligent healthcare tools and utilizing generative AI solutions, we put the control
of well-being back into hands of users, so they can understand their data and take steps to engage
in the preventative care they need.

# Intelligent
# Healthcare Tools

Our smart wearables - including smart watches and bands capable of 24/7 health monitoring, and smart
hearing solutions which leverage the expertise of leading audiologists - put health at the center of
everything, to deliver personalized and advanced wellness support that's accessible to all.

# Generative AI Solutions

Along with AI-powered sports and sleep coaching algorithms which adjust based on the user's
real-time physiological data, our intelligent tools also use Large Language Model (LLM) in order to
recognize natural language descriptions, for human-like interactions.

# Our Impact

# 42M+

Active Users in 90+ Countries

# **200M+**

Units Shipped Worldwide

# 25+

World-Class Research Partners

# Doing good, *on purpose* —

Impact Fundation is the philanthropic and pro-bono engine behind Impact Fundry. We pool our time,
talent and capital into programmes that change lives — delivered exclusively in partnership with

Why we exist

## Business is the easy part. We measure ourselves by what we give back — quietly, consistently, and
## in places the spotlight rarely reaches.

Across our four companies we have advisors, builders, educators and storytellers. Impact Fundry is

# Your Work
# Your Patients
# Our Purpose

Cloud accessible imaging gets patients out of the dark. Our medical imaging suite empowers
physicians and care staff around the world to deliver the answers patients need. 

[Book a Demo][47]

## Empowering Physicians Everywhere

#### Hospitals & Health Systems

Connect physicians and patient information across departments.

#### Radiology Practices

Streamline reading workflows and centralize imaging data.

#### Cardiology Practices

Optimize access to clinical data and inform patient care.

#### Life
#### Sciences

Enable imaging-based research for clinical trials.

## See How We Uncover Answers

[Illustration of a healthcare professional, possibly a doctor, next to a medical interface. The
interface displays a reminder to ][Illustration of a healthcare professional, possibly a doctor,
next to a medical interface. The interface displays a reminder to ]

#### InteleGence

AI tools to simplify workflows and assist in precision diagnostics.

[Learn More][48]
[A graphic illustration of a person in a lab coat sitting at a desk and looking at knee joint X-rays
on two computer monitors. The person, with dark hair pulled back by a pink band, interacts with the
computer using a mouse.][A graphic illustration of a person in a lab coat sitting at a desk and
looking at knee joint X-rays on two computer monitors. The person, with dark hair pulled back by a
pink band, interacts with the computer using a mouse.]

#### InteleOrchestrator

Orchestrate clinical workflows with an AI-enhanced worklist.

[Learn More][49]
[Illustration of a doctor in a white coat examining a clipboard. He stands next to a medical imaging
machine. Icons representing a brain scan, emails, and a cloud are displayed around him, suggesting
data analysis or telemedicine.][Illustration of a doctor in a white coat examining a clipboard. He
stands next to a medical imaging machine. Icons representing a brain scan, emails, and a cloud are
displayed around him, suggesting data analysis or telemedicine.]

#### InteleShare

Send and receive patient imaging securely and smoothly.
[Learn More][50]
[Explore More Products][51]
[...][...]

We’re connecting healthcare professionals and imaging information so you can focus on what really
matters: patient care.

# 16 - 19 November 2026 Meet Health. Future. People.
# **VISIT MEDICA 2026.**

Experience innovations and trends first-hand. Make the most of the opportunity to share experiences
and information, and benefit from networking and new business contacts.

## A Platform for Tomorrow’s Healthcare

## Where Medicine, Technology and Industry Come Together

MEDICA brings together international stakeholders from medicine, technology, industry, and
policymaking. The focus is on integrated solutions that address the challenges of modern healthcare
systems, as well as the exchange of knowledge on their practical implementation. Through curated
formats, clearly defined thematic focus areas, and a high-level conference program, MEDICA provides
exhibitors and visitors with a platform for orientation, networking, and insights into the
developments shaping the future of healthcare.

With expanding expertise and new vertically integrated global capabilities, MGS is transforming our
customers’ most pressing challenges into innovations that improve lives. Learn why we’re the
healthcare contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) of choice for today’s leading
Pharma, Diagnostic & MedTech Companies.

[Discover The MGS Advantage][65]

Our expanding global footprint gives customer access to our CDMO expertise and experience,
strategically located closer to home.

## Speed-to-Market From Ideation to Delivery

**Our Complete Value Chain Solution** mitigates risk, maximizes resources and gives customers easy
access to smarter strategies and customized end-to-end solutions. A seamless transition from
development to tooling to automation to high-volume manufacturing speeds the delivery of the highly
critical, high-precision components customers count on.

[Product Design and Development]

### Healthcare Product Design and Development

Our human touch approach guides our process from idea generation through final MDR/FDA approval.
Deep R&D competencies, extensive healthcare industry experience and strong technical expertise
support customers in all aspects of early-stage product design and development. Be sure to set your
program up for long-term success.

[Learn More][99]

### World-Class Tooling Worldwide

Building on MGS’ rich tooling heritage and the acquisitions of forward-thinking moldmaking partners,
we deliver precision tooling solutions – from multicomponent to stack to high cavitation molds.
Learn how our global moldmaking expertise and capacity enable us to deliver your large-scale,
complex medical programs with speed and precision.

[Learn More][100]

### Customized Automation Solutions

Our custom automation equipment technologies optimize your final production environments, leveraging
decades of expertise in toolmaking and molding. Complete in-house capabilities integrate custom
assembly, part orientation and performance validation technologies to maximize performance and
productivity at customer locations and our own.

[Learn More][101]

### Global Manufacturing

Our expertise culminates in manufacturing the highly critical, high-precision components leading
healthcare innovators count on. With a focus on Quality, Precision Molding and Value-Added Assembly,
we deliver manufacturing excellence around the world. Access more than 250,000 sq. ft. of cleanroom
manufacturing capacity now strategically located closer to you.

## Speed-to-Market From Ideation to Delivery

**Our Complete Value Chain Solution** mitigates risk, maximizes resources and gives customers easy
access to smarter strategies and customized end-to-end solutions. A seamless transition from
development to tooling to automation to high-volume manufacturing speeds the delivery of the highly
critical, high-precision components customers count on.

[Product Design and Development]

### Healthcare Product Design and Development

Our human touch approach guides our process from idea generation through final MDR/FDA approval.
Deep R&D competencies, extensive healthcare industry experience and strong technical expertise
support customers in all aspects of early-stage product design and development. Be sure to set your
program up for long-term success.

[Learn More][99]

### World-Class Tooling Worldwide

Building on MGS’ rich tooling heritage and the acquisitions of forward-thinking moldmaking partners,
we deliver precision tooling solutions – from multicomponent to stack to high cavitation molds.
Learn how our global moldmaking expertise and capacity enable us to deliver your large-scale,
complex medical programs with speed and precision.

[Learn More][100]

### Customized Automation Solutions

Our custom automation equipment technologies optimize your final production environments, leveraging
decades of expertise in toolmaking and molding. Complete in-house capabilities integrate custom
assembly, part orientation and performance validation technologies to maximize performance and
productivity at customer locations and our own.

[Learn More][101]

### Global Manufacturing

Our expertise culminates in manufacturing the highly critical, high-precision components leading
healthcare innovators count on. With a focus on Quality, Precision Molding and Value-Added Assembly,
we deliver manufacturing excellence around the world. Access more than 250,000 sq. ft. of cleanroom
manufacturing capacity now strategically located closer to you.

## FAQs

Net Health

### Who is Net Health?

Net Health builds technology for the moments that matter between a clinician and a patient. It’s a
mission that started in 1993 and, over the decades, has continued to grow through expert and
specialized knowledge spanning the continuum of care. Today, the result is AI-native intelligence
that works within our legacy tools to support care across the full patient journey, from hospital to
home.

### What solutions does Net Health offer? 

Net Health is an AI-native specialty and clinical intelligence platform built on more than 30 years
of expert knowledge and quality patient outcomes. We support more than 34,000 healthcare
organizations across the continuum of care in rehab therapy, wound care, occupational health, and
skilled nursing as they optimize workflows, engage patients, and improve clinical outcomes. Our AI
is built into the core of the technology, not through a third party or added on.

Our solutions include ReDoc and Optima for rehab therapy, WoundExpert and Tissue Analytics for wound
care, and Value-Based Care Solutions for skilled nursing, each shaped by the clinical realities of
that specialty. Net Health continues to deepen this specialty knowledge as a trusted technology
partner to leading healthcare institutions throughout the United States.

Net Health’s specialty platform helps organizations stay compliant, streamline documentation, staff
more efficiently, and secure proper reimbursement. At hospitals, outpatient and private practice
clinics, post-acute facilities, and skilled nursing settings, AI-native tools recognize the
specialty-specific workflows and realities clinicians face to deliver better outcomes and make
confident, data-informed decisions. Net Health’s platform helps teams reduce errors, improve
efficiency, and support care coordination and growth.

### What healthcare analytics options does Net Health offer?

analytics solutions like Tissue Analytics and Value-based Care Solutions turn data into insights
clinicians can act on, supporting better decisions and better patient outcomes at the point of care.

record (EMR) and integrates with the systems many organizations already use. They support hospitals,
outpatient clinics, private practices, post-acute facilities, and clinicians delivering care in the

tracking. ReDoc and Optima support rehab therapy across outpatient, post-acute, and skilled nursing

# Welcome to OnPatient

The easy way to manage your personal health records

[Sign Up][4] [COVID-19 Updates][5]

## Take control of your medical records.

Securely connect with all your medical providers with OnPatient, trusted by over 13 million users.
Gain access to your information via web or the OnPatient App.

[[Onpatient patient portal on ipad, iphone, or web]][6]

## How to Connect

[envelope show to send email invite to patients to access Onpatient icon]

#### STEP 1

Ask your provider to send you an email invite to the OnPatient Portal.

[Check list on how to sign up icon]

#### STEP 2

Open the OnPatient invite email, press the “sign up” button and register online.

[ipad and iphone downloading app icon]

#### STEP 3

[Download][7] the OnPatient app from the Apple App Store.

[continual user icon]

#### STEP 4

Launch the OnPatient app and log in to connect to your medical provider.

## Through the OnPatient portal, you can
* Fill out any paperwork before your appointment to make checking in easier
* View your upcoming appointments and check-in online
* Schedule and cancel appointments from your computer or mobile device
* Message your doctor through a HIPAA compliant portal
* Manage your contact and insurance information
* Access your medical record
* Have educational material sent directly to your account
* Connect your child's account and manage their health record with yours
* View statements and pay online

* Each practice personalizes OnPatient, some of these features may not be available.

### The Best Telehealth Providers of 2025

Our Top Picks
* ### Sesame
  
  [Sesame logo]
  
  Sesame offers personal care for telehealth patients. Doctors are local to you and you’re able to
  schedule a visit in-person or virtually–whichever fits your schedule best.
  
  [Learn More][34]
* ### BetterHelp
  
  [BetterHelp logo]
  
  BetterHelp connects patients with reputable mental health professionals through secure phone,
  video, or live chat sessions for professional and convenient mental and behavioral health therapy.
  As a BetterHelp affiliate, we may receive compensation from BetterHelp if you purchase products or
  services through the links provided.
  
  [Learn More][35]
* ### Hims
  
  [Hims logo]
  
  Hims is an online health provider dedicated to helping men with various issues. Whether you’re
  hoping to lose weight, reduce your anxiety, improve your sexual performance, or regrow your hair,
  Hims is here to help. In-person visits are not required – you’ll receive all the assistance and
  support you need through the Hims app.
  
  [Learn More][36]

## Experience
## a better route

## FOR HEALTHCARE STAFFING

## Where expertise meets every specialty

We are your partners in nursing, specialized medicine and more.

## Where Early Detection Begins

## Breast Imaging

Early detection saves lives—and it starts with the specialists behind the screen. Trusted Talent
staffs ARRT-registered mammography technologists, breast imaging radiologists, and sonographers who
bring precision and patient-first care to every exam: screening and diagnostic mammography, breast
ultrasound, breast MRI, and image-guided biopsies (stereotactic and ultrasound-guided). The result:
faster reads, clearer answers, and patients who feel cared for at every step.

## Behind Every Smooth Operation

## Anesthesiology

From ORs to outpatient, we deliver board-certified anesthesiologists who ensure safety, comfort, and
seamless surgical experiences—because precision behind the scenes makes all the difference. Our
talent knows complex airway cases, regional blocks, and ASA III–IV patients, ensuring preparedness
across surgical settings.

## Compassion at the Core

## Nursing

Nursing is the heartbeat of healthcare. We provide trusted RNs who bring skill, adaptability, and
compassion to every setting—from critical care to community health. Whether managing complex
post-surgical patients, supporting families through vulnerable moments, or coordinating across
specialties, our nurses deliver evidence-based care with humanity at its center.

## Strength in Every Step

## Oncology

Cancer care requires more than treatment—it requires trust, precision, and resilience. We connect
facilities with board-certified oncologists who guide patients through every stage of care, from
initial diagnosis to long-term survivorship. Whether managing complex chemotherapy regimens,
tailoring immunotherapy, or coordinating multidisciplinary tumor boards, our oncologists deliver
both cutting-edge expertise and compassionate support.

## Clarity When It Counts

## Radiology

We place top-tier radiologists who bring accuracy and insight to every scan. The clearer the
diagnosis, the quicker the path to diagnosis and care. Our radiologists are proficient across
modalities—MRI, CT, PET, and interventional techniques—delivering rapid reads with subspecialty
precision.

## Continuity at the Core

## Hospitalists

Our hospitalists are the glue that holds inpatient care together. With deep clinical experience and
real-time responsiveness, they elevate outcomes and satisfaction on every shift. Our hospitalists
manage everything from acute CHF exacerbations to sepsis protocols, coordinating with clinical
leadership and specialists to drive efficient, evidence-based care.

## Expertise from End to End

## Gastroenterology

GI health demands focused skill and compassionate delivery. We staff trusted gastroenterologists who
bring both—improving lives one patient at a time. From managing IBD flares to performing high-volume
colonoscopies and ERCPs, our specialists bring deep procedural and diagnostic expertise to the
table.

Happy they are based out of NY. I heard they use “agents” you don’t speak to but this is not true. I

they are so responsive. I can understand them and what they are saying unlike these outsourced

## a better route

## FOR HEALTHCARE STAFFING

## Where expertise meets every specialty

We are your partners in nursing, specialized medicine and more.

## Where Early Detection Begins

## Breast Imaging

Early detection saves lives—and it starts with the specialists behind the screen. Trusted Talent
staffs ARRT-registered mammography technologists, breast imaging radiologists, and sonographers who
bring precision and patient-first care to every exam: screening and diagnostic mammography, breast
ultrasound, breast MRI, and image-guided biopsies (stereotactic and ultrasound-guided). The result:
faster reads, clearer answers, and patients who feel cared for at every step.

## Behind Every Smooth Operation

## Anesthesiology

From ORs to outpatient, we deliver board-certified anesthesiologists who ensure safety, comfort, and
seamless surgical experiences—because precision behind the scenes makes all the difference. Our
talent knows complex airway cases, regional blocks, and ASA III–IV patients, ensuring preparedness
across surgical settings.

## Compassion at the Core

## Nursing

Nursing is the heartbeat of healthcare. We provide trusted RNs who bring skill, adaptability, and
compassion to every setting—from critical care to community health. Whether managing complex
post-surgical patients, supporting families through vulnerable moments, or coordinating across
specialties, our nurses deliver evidence-based care with humanity at its center.

## Strength in Every Step

## Oncology

Cancer care requires more than treatment—it requires trust, precision, and resilience. We connect
facilities with board-certified oncologists who guide patients through every stage of care, from
initial diagnosis to long-term survivorship. Whether managing complex chemotherapy regimens,
tailoring immunotherapy, or coordinating multidisciplinary tumor boards, our oncologists deliver
both cutting-edge expertise and compassionate support.

## Clarity When It Counts

## Radiology

We place top-tier radiologists who bring accuracy and insight to every scan. The clearer the
diagnosis, the quicker the path to diagnosis and care. Our radiologists are proficient across
modalities—MRI, CT, PET, and interventional techniques—delivering rapid reads with subspecialty
precision.

## Continuity at the Core

## Hospitalists

Our hospitalists are the glue that holds inpatient care together. With deep clinical experience and
real-time responsiveness, they elevate outcomes and satisfaction on every shift. Our hospitalists
manage everything from acute CHF exacerbations to sepsis protocols, coordinating with clinical
leadership and specialists to drive efficient, evidence-based care.

## Expertise from End to End

## Gastroenterology

GI health demands focused skill and compassionate delivery. We staff trusted gastroenterologists who
bring both—improving lives one patient at a time. From managing IBD flares to performing high-volume
colonoscopies and ERCPs, our specialists bring deep procedural and diagnostic expertise to the
table.

# Empowering Health, Inspiring Joy

Enabling Individuals to Take Control of their Well-being with Intelligent Healthcare Tools.

## **Zepp Health is committed to delivering cutting-edge smart wearable healthcare solutions that go
## beyond necessity, to inspire and bring joy to our users.**

# A World-Leading Health & Fitness Ecosystem

We empower users to live their healthiest lives by optimizing their health, fitness, and wellness
journeys through our cutting-edge smart watches, bands, hearables and soundscape service.

# With You Every Moment

Our proprietary Zepp Digital Health Management Platform, which includes the Zepp OS, AI chips,
biometric sensors, and data algorithms, delivers cloud-based 24/7 actionable insights and guidance
to help users attain their wellness goals.

# Putting the Control Back
# into the Hands of Users

By developing intelligent healthcare tools and utilizing generative AI solutions, we put the control
of well-being back into hands of users, so they can understand their data and take steps to engage
in the preventative care they need.

# Intelligent
# Healthcare Tools

Our smart wearables - including smart watches and bands capable of 24/7 health monitoring, and smart
hearing solutions which leverage the expertise of leading audiologists - put health at the center of
everything, to deliver personalized and advanced wellness support that's accessible to all.

# Generative AI Solutions

Along with AI-powered sports and sleep coaching algorithms which adjust based on the user's
real-time physiological data, our intelligent tools also use Large Language Model (LLM) in order to
recognize natural language descriptions, for human-like interactions.

# Our Impact

# 42M+

Active Users in 90+ Countries

# **200M+**

Units Shipped Worldwide

# 25+

World-Class Research Partners

Suspected Atrial Fibrillation Events Detected
